packageRules.description: Keep tooling images on version tags; production service images carry their digest beside the tag.
Leave first-party release images to pin-release.yaml: each release dispatches it once all its images are published, so no update pins half a release.
Resolve Terraform providers and modules from the registry used by OpenTofu.
Review the stable Google provider and service-agent beta provider together.
Review the Sentry provider's updates: it is pre-1.0, so a minor release may break the configuration.

Leave the other actions in the managed governance workflows to `a-novel repo update`, which renders them from the stack's templates, where the stack's Renovate keeps their commit pins current. An update here would be reverted at the next reconcile. Their a-novel-kit/workflows pins stay with Renovate, since the reconcile keeps a deployed pin newer than its template's.
Resolve Aqua Security tags directly from Git because its organization IP allow list rejects authenticated GitHub GraphQL lookups.
Let the OpenTofu managers own required_version instead of treating it as HashiCorp Terraform.
Keep the OpenTofu binary and root constraints on one version.
Hold OpenTofu and provider releases for a week. Pull-request plans run the new binaries with the read-only production identity, so the release age bounds a compromised upstream release.

Let patch releases through after six hours so fixes land quickly. Renovate classifies each candidate against the current version, so a release that changes the minor or major version keeps the week-long hold even when it is itself a patch, such as 1.1.2 to 1.2.2.
Refresh the host programs' module with the native Go manager.
Hold google.golang.org/api off v0.299.0 because its module graph forces vulnerable gRPC v1.84.0; admit the first later release.
Resolve only declared tools in the isolated linter module, on separate branches from runtime dependencies.
Resolve only the declared tool in the isolated vulnerability-scanner module, on a branch apart from the linter and runtime dependencies.
Require review for production configuration and infrastructure definitions.

customManagers.description: Keep each root's OpenTofu constraint aligned with the version file.
Update pinned workflow tool versions declared beside Renovate metadata.
